# Copilot Instructions

- This repository is the ASG Airlines Data Engineering assessment.
- The local stack is Python and MySQL; Azure is the future deployment target.
- Preserve raw source data and keep processing batch-oriented and traceable.
- Treat the ASG Airlines Edge Case Rulebook as locked. Do not silently change or reinterpret business rules.
- Keep the project practical. Prefer small, readable functions and avoid unnecessary abstractions.
- Never hardcode credentials or secrets.
- Automatic corrections must eventually be auditable, and invalid or unresolved records must eventually be quarantined.
- Add focused tests for important business rules and edge cases.
- Keep implementation understandable enough to explain in a student data engineering interview.
